Liam O'Connor: Hi all - I've submitted my resignation. Last day will be 2026-08-20. Need help with benefits cut-off, COBRA timing, exit interview, and device return.

Priya Singh: Thanks for the heads up Liam. We'll run the final payroll calculation and PTO payout. Benefits stay active through 2026-08-20; COBRA election window starts 2026-08-21. I'll schedule the exit interview - any preferred times?

Liam O'Connor: Morning slots preferred. Also asking if I can have read-only access to shared customer docs for 2 weeks after last day to assist with questions.

it-ops: Device return: IT ticket IT-#79210 will be created. Default drop-off within 7 days; we can provide a pre-paid label if needed. SSO and prod keys disabled 2026-08-20 18:00 PT. For read-only exceptions, manager+HR must approve and we will audit access.

people-ops-bot: Please complete the resignation form: https://redwoodhr.company/resignations (within 48 hours) so HR can trigger final pay and benefits steps.

Priya Singh: Noted on read-only request - please DM the list of docs/repos and we'll route approval. Exit interview draft set for 2026-08-18 10:00 AM; change if needed.

Liam O'Connor: DM sent with doc paths. Thanks everyone.

Priya Singh: Final checklist: submit form, return assets, sign any exit paperwork, review COBRA packet when sent, confirm payroll date. We'll email COBRA instructions to your personal address on file.

Liam O'Connor: Will confirm personal email and the return address for the laptop. Appreciate it.
